scope: Full core, actual VS Code development and production-installed, plus package checks. Controlled HTTP models do not measure semantic quality.
retry: Only failed jobs were requested again at the identical commit. Windows passed on retry; Ubuntu evidence is its original successful run. No code, assertion or timeout changes were made for the retry. This does not establish or fix the timeout's root cause.
